north_america.sampling_unit: standardized route stop conditional on at least one calling species
north_america.response: mean species richness per active stop; excess richness equals alpha_active - 1

existing_authorized_result.direction: wetter member has greater active-unit taxonomic depth

rainfall_exposure.definition: zscore(log1p(number of complete coordinate-local calendar days immediately preceding the repaired event date until the first day with >=1 mm precipitation, capped at 30 days))

australia.primary_response: excess_richness = species_richness - 1; all retained FrogID recordings already have richness >= 1

primary_model.formula: excess_richness ~ dry_z + C(state) * C(month) + year_z + sin_hour + cos_hour

sensitivities.recorder_cluster: same primary OLS formula clustered by recorder
sensitivities.within_cell: demeaned within-ERA5-cell OLS using dry_z, year_z, month indicators, sin_hour and cos_hour; support if beta_dry_z < 0 and complete 95% CI < 0

secondary_endpoints_no_gate: threeplus = I(species_richness >= 3), logistic model with the same covariates and ERA5-cell clustering
excess_beyond_two = max(species_richness - 2, 0), OLS with the same covariates and ERA5-cell clustering

cross_system_decision.pass: Australian primary continuous-depth support AND frozen NAAMP active-alpha 95% CI > 0.
cross_system_decision.strong_pass: PASS plus both Australian continuous-depth sensitivities have 95% CIs below zero.
cross_system_decision.reason: The systems use different rainfall-exposure scales and observation designs; comparison is directional on a shared active-unit taxonomic-depth estimand.

interpretation_boundaries: Cross-continental consistency is not worldwide universality.
FrogID recordings and NAAMP stops are different observation systems.
The result concerns behaviourally realized acoustic richness conditional on acoustic activity, not occupancy or abundance.
The North American four-component species x stop matrix geometry cannot be replicated in FrogID because FrogID lacks fixed ten-stop route matrices.
The historical >=2-species conditional discrepancy remains part of the record and is not overwritten.
